240. The Crisis of the Red-Clan(3)
Patlock and Pevlock.
While the two fortresses were preparing for the operation of their airborne fortresses, Elona did not attack them. They needed time to organize the information they got from Gaila.
The Royal Palace couldn't foresee that the Red-Clan would betray them at this time.

Firstly, the Royal Palace identified Elona's corruption relatively late. Only the forces who went directly to hell and the ones who had a direct combat with Kelliark could immediately know about her changes.

Of course, afterwards, Elona immediately sorted out the Pro-Veradin forces in Zipfel as per Kelliark's orders, and let the world know that the power structure of Lutero has changed. But nobody could foresee that she would attack the Red-Clan immediately.

Moreover, the fact that Elona gained the ability of 'mental domination' through the Holy Water Tube is a situation only speculated by the Vamel Union, which owns the Record Magician. As far as the Royal Palace knew, Elona just sided with Kelliark and became stronger.
Chiing...!
In the air above the 3rd city, the Pat fleet was preparing for a space jump.

The airborne fortresses of the Red-Clan had the shape of a giant top. There are gates that surpass the size of regular warships on every side, and the sharply trimmed bottom seemed to be able to wreck any hard ground.

From the Red-Clan's point of view, it could possibly be the final battle. There were no minimum guard forces left in the city, and all Red-Clans who did not become immortal were boarding the Pat and its fleet.
"I have no choice but to hope that Shimat's judgment was correct."
Shimat nodded his head resolutely at Rakiman's words.
"The deaths of our Gaila and 4th City comrades won't be in vain. We will be able to meet our comrades in the divine world soon."

At first, Rakiman opposed it saying it was crazy talk, but as the event began, he was shivering at the power that increased due to the sacrifices of his comrades and the first activated power source of Pat.
Pat was vibrating as if it could annihilate any enemy at any moment. Despite the lack of blood leading to only about 50% power for about three hours, it was enough to make the Red-Clan hopeful.
"Open the dimension gate!"
At Rakiman's shout, the central part of Pat opened like a mouth. The power source, which looked like a red sun, was fully exposed.

The moment the power source was exposed could be considered the only weak moment of the airborne fortress. There were no other occasions for the power source to be exposed, except for when making such large-scale dimensional moves.
Faaaaa…!
A massive beam of light poured from the power source. The beam moved like a brush, forming a dimensional gate by drawing a square.
"Coordinates, Firuol. The invasion begins."

The fleet began to fly through the dimensional gate, led by Patlok. The only forces that could use such a large-scale spatial movement at the moment were the Red Plutonian tribe, Kinzelo, and the Silkyia of the Underworld.
While it would take much longer to paint the unmarked ground, it was enough to move the Middle World in 10 minutes.
Without warning, without any precursors.

The sky of the small city of Firuol was being stained red as if blood was spreading. When the ancient renowned King tribes conquered the underground in the past, the red sky was a symbol of destruction.
It meant that the aerial fortress of the Red Plutonian tribe was appearing.
"What on earth... Red Plutonian tribe, what kind of madness is this!"
Manof Vermont.
As good as one of the emperor's henchmen along with Bivol Vermont, he could only stare wide-eyed at the sky.
Even when Orgal unexpectedly visited him not long ago, he was not at all flustered. However, this was the most shocking moment in his life, which had continued for over 10,000 years.
'I knew they were preparing for betrayal... Already!?'

The royal family had been under the illusion that they had the Red Plutonian tribe completely under control. They had meticulously controlled the blood supply to make sure they couldn't operate the aerial fortress at their own discretion.
'Those madmen, they used the blood of our own...!'

Sacrificing tribesmen to operate it was unprecedented. The royal family only thought that the Red Plutonian tribe could choose to sacrifice their tribesmen to operate the aerial fortress on the verge of extinction.

Manof hurriedly rushed out of the window to look at the city. He saw miners busily carrying the bodies of the fallen Blue Plutonian tribesmen. Some of the self-aware miners stopped what they were doing and looked up at the sky.
'No, if these people fall into their hands...'
The aerial fortress of the Third City, Patlok, was nearing completion.
If even one of those horrific weapons that terrified all creatures living underground in ancient times were to be completed, it would pose an insurmountable problem for the current royal family.
Today, by chance, was the day the royal family had moved the 'largest number' of Blue Plutonian tribesmen to Firuol.
Recently, the Blue Plutonian tribesman Eltiet was regaining his perception abilities, so there was a need to hide the fallen tribesmen from him.
The fallen Blue Plutonian tribesmen were to be gradually supported by the Red Plutonian tribe anyway, so they were temporarily stored in Firuol and were to be divided into various bases after today.
In the end, that choice turned out to be the worst decision.
At the moment when Manof's mind went blank, the Red Plutonian tribe was excitedly shouting.
"Ch... Clear Clan! Just how much of that sweet Clear Clan's blood do they have? Shymart kin, look at that! It's a number that you can't even count right at a glance!"
Rakiman raised his voice almost like a child.
Shymart also checked the Clear Clan internees with his chest fluttering. He thought he would find at most about 500 internees, but it wasn't just that.
There were more than 5,000 internees at a rough estimate. Moreover, more internees were likely to be stored within the city.
"There's something called a lottery in the human world, Rakiman kin. It brings great fortune at a very low probability... We, now, have won the lottery."
"Kuahaha, Kahahaha!"
Of course, the fact that there are many internees being transported means that there are also many mines.
But the Red Clan didn't even care about the mines that were about to enter combat. If it was hand-to-hand combat, it might be different, but with the aerial fortress, the mines were nothing.
"High-ranking royal bureaucrat, Manof Bemunt has been identified! Rakiman kin, give the command!"
"Catch him alive at all costs! He will know the power of the Peitel and won't even think about fighting back. He will want to escape using the mines as a shield. Immediately shatter his hopes!"
"Red name!"
As Rakiman said, Manof was ready to run away right away.
Pireol was one of the major research areas for the mines, so self-destruct devices were well prepared. All he had to do was set the self-destruction and pass through the pre-installed dimension gate.
But if it was so easy to escape from the aerial fortress, the powerful beings of the ancient underground world would not have trembled so much.
"Huh, huh...!"
Manof felt his breath hitch as he ran towards the dimensional gate.
The moment they succeeded in the spatial leap, the Red Clan spread the enemy brainwave over the entire Pireol through Peitel.
The wave had a similar effect to Tess's oppression. Everyone touched by the wave feels their body become heavy and a sense of powerlessness.

Moreover, there were two types of waves. The other one was a wave that disables the enemy's communication devices and dimensional gates, and it had the effect of forcibly cutting off the power of these devices.
Thump, thump! Ttung!

Manof was frantically pressing the button to open the walls of the fortress. The fortress and laboratory that the royal family built in Pireol were equipped with various devices operating based on magic, but all of them were completely shut down.
"Damn it, you bastards!"

Manof knew about the ability of the aerial fortress, so in fact, he knew it was already over. He just found it hard to accept that he was being so easily overtaken by those he had considered leashed dogs all along.
Forcing his way through a few barriers, Manoph reached the room where the self-destruction device and dimensional gate were located. However, these devices were already inoperative.
Even when Manoph tried to infuse them with his own magic power, it didn't work. The damaged magic circuit couldn't be fixed in an instant.
"Ha."
Manoph couldn't see the situation outside, but he could guess.
The main guns of the aerial fortress Patlok and the fleet would be dealing with the Mains only, without damaging the Chongmyong buried ones.

'If Temer Vermont was here, we might have had a chance to escape... But of course, Temer is in Meisil. No, it's probably better that he's in Meisil. I don't know how they managed to operate the aerial fortress and carry out this treason, but they wouldn't have left Meisil, where His Majesty is, alone.'

As Manoph had anticipated, a red hell was unfolding outside the fortress. Mains were being oxidized as they touched the tens of thousands of red light strands falling from the aerial fortress, and Chongmyong people were being absorbed in real time.
Adding up all the Chongmyong burials left in the fortress now, there would be more than enough to fully power the Patlok.
The remaining burials would go to other aerial fortresses of the enemies, in turn.
'All I can hope for now is that those who attacked Meisil will be defeated by His Majesty and Eltie.'
Having thought up to this point, Manoph took out a short sword from his bosom.
But his hand didn't move. Not because he was afraid of death, but because the concentration of enemy brainwaves suddenly increased explosively.
"No, Manoph Vermont. It's not like the Melka, known since ancient times for their tenacious vitality, to commit suicide, is it?"
Shimat, who had somehow escaped from the fortress, was approaching.
The Mains had already been perfectly removed. The enemies were all jumping out of their ships and enjoying the festival of blood.
"Shimat... I never thought you'd stab us in the back at this point."
"How dare you, the Melka, think you could ever have led the great enemies like dogs. Well, that must have been the greatest glory of your lives."
Soon Shimat grabbed Manoph's head.
"There is only one reason I kept you alive, Manoph Vermont."
"....What is it?"
"Tell us where our god is. I promise you, on the honor of the enemies. Then, we will not completely destroy your royal family."
"Heh, do you mean to use us as we have used you?"
At that, Shimat smiled as if he couldn't believe it.

"Do you think we need the help of the Melka now that we've regained our power? It seems you still have faith, but without the help of a large force like Vamel or Luther, this fight is over. What I mean is, I'll spare one bloodline of the royal family. Just one surviving as a slave of the enemies. After all, for your Melka, survival itself is the most important thing, not how you live."
